models.title: Common flux and induced voltage
models.formula: Phi/Phi_peak = sin(theta); v1/v1_peak = cos(theta); v2/v1_peak = (N2/N1) cos(theta)
models.assumptions: Ideal coupling, no saturation/leakage, sinusoidal flux, arbitrary normalized amplitude; animation speed is illustrative. Symbolic winding loops are not exact turn counts.
models.checks: Derivative of sin is cos; voltage zero at flux extrema; secondary/primary ratio remains N2/N1.

models.title: Ideal transformer with resistive load
models.assumptions: Ideal, sinusoidal 120 V rms, resistive load, no physical current/thermal rating asserted.
models.checks: V1I1=V2I2, V1/I1=a^2R across full range. Course point a=0.5,R=40 -> V2=240,I2=6,I1=12,P=1440.

models.title: Speaker matching and source power budget
models.formula: n=N2/N1; Zin=9/n^2; I1=10/(1+Zin); Pload=I1^2Zin; Ploss=I1^2; n_opt=3
models.parameters: n = 0.5..6; source 10 V rms and 1 ohm internal; speaker 9 ohm
models.assumptions: Single-frequency resistive speaker approximation, ideal transformer; no acoustical output power assertion.
models.checks: Direct-equivalent n=1 ->9 W; matched n=3 ->25 W; source watts equal load plus internal loss.

models.title: Complex loads and their current/power phasors
models.formula: V2=100 rms; Z=50+jX; I2=V2/Z; I1=2I2; S=V2 conjugate(I2)
models.assumptions: Ideal 100:200 transformer. Phasor current and voltage have distinct visual scales, normalized waveform peaks; RMS calculations are exact.
models.checks: R:200+j0 VA; RL:100+j100 VA; RC:100-j100 VA; input/output complex power equal.

models.title: Approximate equivalent circuit and reference-side change
models.assumptions: Rounded source example values; excitation branch moved to input. Referring a circuit does not physically move a winding.
models.checks: All LV impedances exactly 1/100 HV; rated V^2/Rc=100 W on both sides.

models.title: OC/SC parameter extraction with explicitly illustrative scaling
models.parameters: OC:220 V,2.5 A,100 W LV; SC:150 V,4.55 A,215 W HV; demonstration scaling 0.5..1
models.assumptions: Original data at100%; V and I scale by k, P by k^2 at other settings, which are calculated, not measured. Positive power and P<=VI.
models.checks: OC Rc_L=484,Xm_L=89.4916316577; SC R_H=10.3852191764,X_H=31.2885360045. Scaling and side-referring preserve recovered constants consistently.

models.title: Open-terminal comparison of two equal secondary voltages
models.parameters: Two 220 V rms sources; lower terminals joined, upper connection open
models.assumptions: Equal frequency/magnitude ideal sources and high-impedance voltmeter. Only voltage compatibility tested; no prospective current prediction.

models.title: Regulation from the complete series-drop phasor
models.parameters: k=0..1; PF=0.2..1; plus current-imaginary for leading, minus for lagging
models.assumptions: All values HV-referred, loaded voltage fixed2200V to solve required supply, no-load voltage approximated by E; source held fixed for each loaded/unloaded comparison. Excitation current omitted.
models.checks: k=.75,PF=.6 -> +4.8596354678% lagging / -2.8224458286% leading; k0 ->0; leading/lagging coincide at unityPF.

models.title: Loss-based efficiency curve and optimum current fraction
models.assumptions: Constant rated voltage/frequency and core loss; fixed winding resistance, no thermal/stray/excitation copper-loss correction. Curve calculated, not measured.

errata.issue: Reactive power is labeled S in places; rms numerical values are used despite m subscripts; early-rounded reactive-case power is shown as99.7W/var.
errata.resolution: Use S=P+jQ, |S| in VA, P in W and Q in var, with explicit rms phasors. Exact given loads yield P100W and Q=+/-100var. Instantaneous currents are reconstructed with sqrt(2) times rms magnitude.

errata.issue: Printed SC relation appears as Zeq=V1/R1.
errata.resolution: Corrected to Zeq=Vsc/Isc, dimensions ohms. R=V/R has current units and cannot be impedance.

errata.issue: Both negative induced-EMF and positive terminal-voltage derivative forms appear without a complete reference explanation.
errata.resolution: Body distinguishes induced loop EMF -dλ/dt from passive winding terminal voltage +dλ/dt.

errata.issue: The OC current subtraction is a phasor relationship; an ambiguous scalar subtraction is shown/questioned.
errata.resolution: Use Im=sqrt(Ioc²-Ic²) for orthogonal component magnitudes.

errata.issue: Rounding Ic,H to0.045 A and Im,H to0.246 A gives Xm,H≈8940ohm.
errata.resolution: Full precision raw-data result8949.163ohm in extraction; circuit inspector uses supplied rounded8940ohm clearly labeled as a chosen parameter set.

errata.issue: Loaded2200V held as reference; the lagging and leading cases solve different primary supply magnitudes.
errata.resolution: Do not imply both loaded cases use a common2200V primary. Each regulation comparison holds its separately computed primary supply fixed while unloading.

errata.issue: Measured SC4.55A is rounded and is not exactly the nameplate rated current10000/2200=4.5454545A.
errata.resolution: Extraction preserves measured4.55A; loading examples use exact rated current with stated rounded series parameters. Result differences are rounding only.
